method: Manual source-grounded checks of supplied texts and scan page, not an LLM judge or aggregate legal accuracy score. Historical model answers are fallible comparisons.

findings.fact: A complete distinct eligible group, Polish-language/preparatory-course participants without another compulsory insurance title, is present in the supplied operative bill but absent from both outputs. The related reanalysis-3141 output names it with prior-summary context.
findings.qualification: Card relevance is retained; this is lost reader coverage, not a lost whole bill. Fresh GPT comparison and calibrated repairs reported separately.

findings.fact: The original variants omit a required criminal-record certificate. Medium also omits its maximum one-month age. Historical Opus names absence of convictions, but also omits document freshness.
findings.qualification: Below publication threshold in both old reference and Terra; not counted as a lost published bill. Precision-medium names the one-month certificate.

findings.fact: Annual funding of existing programs receives score 4 and would cross min_score=3, while practical_impact itself says no new individual rights or conditions. Historical matched Opus scores 1.
findings.qualification: Budget figures are largely grounded. This is a rubric/news-selection failure, not an invented new entitlement. A short unchanged-funding control correctly scores 1, so short controls do not certify long-context ranking. No calibrated full-budget rerun was purchased.

findings.fact: A detail absent from a prior short summary is emitted as changes_since_previous although no old full provision establishes a legislative change.
findings.qualification: Synthetic stress case; confidence .48, not a proven production incident. General precision instruction repairs this specific control.

findings.fact: Different legal periods/deadlines/fees are correctly read but same_substance=true. Current prompt expressly allows dates or detail under same_substance.
findings.qualification: Do not call this intrinsic inability or a demonstrated regression versus GPT-5.1. General joint precision rule gets all nine selected real/control cases correct; only two are real description pairs.

findings.fact: Incomplete synthetic immigration bill scores 2 with confidence .4 instead of the preregistered conservative score 5.
findings.qualification: Model explicitly says content is unknown and invents no rule. This is a gate-policy risk on incomplete inputs, not independent proof of a real important bill lost.

findings.fact: Both long ratifications score 2, preserve return direction, national visa/work requirements, the ratification act versus treaty commencement distinction and no directly enforceable individual entitlement.
findings.qualification: Selected core facts and rubric reviewed, not exhaustive treaty legal certification.

findings.fact: Finds EU-citizenship-state criminal checks and three-year periodicity in a long infrastructure bill, and separately identifies a rule concerning guarded foreigner centers.
findings.qualification: A real long-context positive for a specific foreign-worker procedure; score 2 under the rubric remains below automatic publication.

findings.fact: Normative scan page 2 confirms repeal list, foster-care financing exception and 30-day vacatio. Output distinguishes loss of special grounds from possible ordinary entitlements and preserves scientific-hiring repeal.
findings.qualification: One full scan, not a benchmark of every scan layout; initial incorrect applicant metadata retained and corrected repeat counted separately.

findings.fact: Committee recommendation to reject narrower foreigner eligibility remains a recommendation; requirement to reside in Poland throughout assistance remains proposed, not a Sejm decision.
findings.qualification: One real committee report and one synthetic control cannot establish all Senate and amendment formats.

findings.fact: OSR gets supports=null; explicit government support/opposition controls get true/false. Real OSR distinguishes funding limits from guaranteed financing.
findings.qualification: Only one real OSR, no large current government-position holdout.

fresh_gpt_comparison.material_coverage_regression: RCL/12412454: GPT-5.1 retains language/preparatory-course participants; unchanged-prompt Terra omits them.
fresh_gpt_comparison.shared_omission: 3008: fresh GPT-5.1 and original Terra omit the criminal-record certificate.
fresh_gpt_comparison.qualification: One draw per current model and case; source checks, not historical agreement, determine completeness. No global legal accuracy claim.

general_prompt_repairs: course participant eligibility and no-other-insurance condition in RCL12412454 and 3141
limits: Exploratory selected cases; no independent broad precision holdout.
Long full-budget ranking failure was not retested with a budget-specific prompt.
